## Recommendation: contact **American University Washington College of Law first**

AUWCL should be your first priority **if public-interest/public-service work is part of your plan**. Its PIPS program offers a potentially major funding opportunity—a **three-year, full-tuition scholarship**—but requires a separate application and has a firm **January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM EST** deadline. The application steps are clear and online, although Maryland Carey has the simplest general admissions-information outreach.

Then contact **Maryland Carey** for the most straightforward admissions conversation/request, followed by **UBalt** if you want a scheduled one-on-one admissions discussion.

---

## 1. University of Maryland Carey Law

### Request admissions information
- **Direct contact/request page:** [Maryland Carey Law—Contact Admissions](https://www.law.umaryland.edu/admissions--aid/contact-admissions/)
- On that page, select **“JD Applicants”** under “Request Information.”
- You can also contact the Office of Admissions directly:
  - Email: `admissions@law.umaryland.edu`
  - Phone: `(410) 706-3492`
  - Hours listed: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.

### Upcoming online event
- **Direct schedule/registration page:** [JD Webinars](https://www.law.umaryland.edu/admissions--aid/visits--events/jd-webinars/)
- The earliest event currently listed is the **Personal Statement Workshop**, **Wednesday, July 22, 2026, 12:00 PM–1:00 PM**. Register through the “Register here” link beside that session.
- If you prefer an explicitly admissions-focused overview, the schedule also lists **JD Admissions 101 Webinar** on **Thursday, August 13, 2026, 12:00 PM–1:00 PM**.

**Next step:** Submit the JD information request, then register for the July workshop (or the August Admissions 101 session) and use the email address for any individual questions.

---

## 2. University of Baltimore School of Law

### Arrange an admissions meeting
- **Visits, tours, and appointment options:** [Visit the School of Law](https://www.ubalt.edu/law/admission-and-aid/visit/index.cfm)
- **Direct 30-minute phone/Zoom scheduling form:** [UBalt Law Phone Call Registration](https://forms.lsac-unite.org/5810/UBaltLawPhoneCallFall2026.html)

UBalt offers a **30-minute phone or Zoom appointment** with an admissions counselor for in-depth discussion and questions. Its visit page also says you can schedule an **in-person law-school tour** and request an individual meeting with an admissions counselor to accompany it.

Fallback contact details:
- Email: `lawadmissions@ubalt.edu`
- Phone: `(410) 837-4459`
- Business hours listed: 8:30 AM–4:30 PM.

**Next step:** Use the phone/Zoom scheduling form, choose an available session, and include the questions you want covered—application strategy, scholarships, program fit, or career goals. Choose the in-person-tour option on the visit page if you would rather combine a tour with the counselor meeting.

---

## 3. American University Washington College of Law — PIPS Scholarship

### What PIPS is
- **Program page:** [Public Interest/Public Service (PIPS) Scholarship](https://www.american.edu/wcl/impact/initiatives-programs/publicinterest/pipsscholarship/)
- PIPS is a **three-year, full-tuition** scholarship for incoming **full-time JD** students with strong academic credentials and a demonstrated commitment to pursuing public-interest or public-service work after graduation.
- AUWCL describes it as both financial and programmatic support for students planning meaningful public-interest/public-service careers.

### Application and deadline
- **Requirements and selection process:** [PIPS Application & Selection Process](https://www.american.edu/wcl/impact/initiatives-programs/publicinterest/pipsscholarship/application-and-selection-process.cfm)
- **Direct PIPS application:** [Start the PIPS application](https://american.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_6FMJcuOCtqeRJiu)

To be considered, you must submit both:
1. the general JD admissions application, and  
2. the separate electronic PIPS application.

The PIPS application calls for responses to **three short essays**; the school also lists a résumé and an optional but strongly recommended letter of recommendation. The posted deadline is **January 31, 2027, at 11:59 PM EST**. AUWCL says applicants are strongly encouraged to take the LSAT by November so the Admissions Committee can review a completed file.

**Next step:** Open the PIPS application and prepare your LSAC number and email address—the application begins by requesting both. At the same time, make a checklist for the general JD application, résumé, three short responses, and a public-service-focused recommendation letter.

---

### Why this ordering
1. **AUWCL first:** the PIPS deadline and full-tuition potential create the greatest time-sensitive upside.  
2. **Maryland Carey second:** its JD information-request option plus direct email/phone contact is especially simple and low-friction.  
3. **UBalt third:** it is also very accessible, with a concrete 30-minute phone/Zoom booking form and tour-plus-counselor option—ideal once you know the questions you want answered.
